steps.caption: The hosted desktop app opens with an empty packing list, add field, and All / To pack filters.
Passport appears as a new unpacked item and the add field is cleared.
Passport, Socks, and the literal text Hat appear in insertion order, all unpacked.
Before rename, Rain coat is visibly packed while Socks remains unpacked.
Rain coat is in focused edit mode with Save and Cancel actions.
After rename, Jacket remains packed in place, Rain coat is gone, and Socks is unchanged.
The All view initially shows Passport and Socks unpacked.
Passport is packed while Socks remains unpacked, with checkbox, label, and text treatment showing state.
The selected To pack view shows Socks and hides packed Passport.
Back in All, Passport can be marked not packed again and both unpacked items are visible.
With every item packed, To pack shows its dedicated Nothing left to pack state.
Before deletion, Passport, Socks, and Jacket are visible in insertion order.
After deleting Socks, Passport and Jacket remain in order and focus moves to Jacket’s Delete control.
Deleting the remaining items returns the app to its empty-list state.
Immediately before refresh, To pack is selected and shows only Socks; packed Jacket is filtered out and deleted Hat is absent.
After the real refresh, All is restored by default with Jacket still packed, Socks unpacked, and Hat still absent.
The known-good state contains packed Passport.
A whitespace-only add is rejected inline and creates no new row.
After valid input, Socks is added unpacked and the validation message clears without changing packed Passport.
A blank rename stays in edit mode with an associated validation message.
Escape cancels the invalid rename and restores Passport with its packed state intact.
Before the recovery refresh, To pack shows only the valid unpacked Socks item.
After refresh, All shows only the valid saved items: packed Passport and unpacked Socks.
